d:
Grind in silence, let the work speak Hustle Evuryday is Wazir Patar’s new track from his EP Back To Skool, a raw, motivating anthem for everyone chasing their dreams one day at a time.
Wazir Patar sings it and made the music, Manna Shahkot wrote the lyrics, and Dense mixed and mastered it. Put it on for your gym sessions, late-night grind and every early start
